# Empty state

What a panel shows when it has nothing to show, in four variants: empty, no results, error and no permission.

Status: Stable. Semantic versioning applies: nothing breaks without a deprecation first.

A condition, not an apology. The panel is packed with **relleno** — what a mola does with an area that has nothing in it yet — and the words sit on a raised plate above it. Four variants, because they are four different conversations: an empty filter result must never tell someone to “create your first saved reply”.

## Usage

### When to use

- Nothing exists yet, and the action creates the first one.
- Filters hide everything, and the action clears them.
- The panel could not load, and the action retries.
- The content exists but is not the reader’s to see, and the text says who can grant it.

### When not to

- Content that is on its way. Use [Skeleton](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-skeleton--overview.md).
- One slot, such as a chart or an image, waiting for its content. Use [Placeholder](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-placeholder--overview.md).
- A warning about a page that does have content. Use [Callout](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-callout--overview.md).
- A table with no rows; the table’s own empty row keeps the headers. Use [Table](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-table--overview.md).

### Do and don’t

- Do: Pick the variant for the conversation: no-results says filters are hiding things, and clears them.
- Don’t: Tell someone filtering their runs to “create your first run”.
- Do: Say who can grant access in no-permission.
- Don’t: Show “Access denied” with no next step.

### Content

- The title states the condition: “No runs match these filters”, “Traces did not load”.
- The description gives the cause or the count: “3 filters are hiding 1,284 runs.”
- An error says what happened and what happens next: “The trace store returned 503. This panel will try again in 30s.”

## Anatomy

The root carries `data-slot="empty-state"`; each part carries its `data-part`.

1. Slot (`[data-slot="empty-state"]`): A shaded panel packed with relleno: a slot cut and waiting, not a blank rectangle.
2. Seam (`[data-part="seam"]`): The tone’s relleno along the top, on error and no-permission only.
3. Plate (`[data-part="plate"]`): A raised cloth plate, so the copy never reads across the slits.
4. Icon (`[data-part="icon"]`): A small ink square with the variant’s glyph. Not an illustration.
5. Title (`[data-part="title"]`): What state this is, as a heading.
6. Description (`[data-part="description"]`): Why, and what will happen next.
7. Actions (`[data-part="actions"]`): One or two buttons; the first is the way forward.

## API

### `EmptyState` (component)

- `variant`: `empty`, `no-results`, `error`, `no-permission` (default `empty`)
- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg` (default `md`)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | One or two buttons. The first is the way forward. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` |  |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Replace the variant's icon, or `false` for none. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` |  |  |
| `variant` | `"empty" \| "no-results" \| "error" \| "no-permission"` |  |  |

### `emptyStateVariants` (function)

The state a panel is in when it has nothing to show — designed as a condition rather than as an apology.

Types: `EmptyStateProps`

## Accessibility

Nothing in it takes focus, so there is no keyboard table.

### Mola handles

- Renders the title as a real heading at `headingLevel`.
- Gives the `error` variant `role="alert"`, so a failed load is announced.
- Hides the icon and the seam from assistive tech.

### You handle

- Pick the variant that matches the situation, so the words fit it.
- Choose a `headingLevel` that fits the page outline.
- Pass the action that moves the person forward in `actions`.

### Testing status

- Automated, jsdom: each of its 5 stories is rendered and checked with axe on every pull request.
- Automated, browser: every story is checked in Chromium with axe, colour contrast included, in both themes, and for overflow at 390px.
- Keyboard in unit tests: not applicable.
- Screen readers: not yet tested by hand.
